study: %R trend entry filter: buy an empty-square (presquare) arm only when the fast %R has been TRENDING UP over the prior 10 minutes, not sideways. Does it lose less per trade than the live entry, after cost, on sessions it has never been looked at on?
registered_at: 2026-10-09 ~15:55 ET (operator chose the replay-variant test over a live switch), before the knob or any replay of it exists
origin: Operator 10/9 (GME 15:21, RBLX 14:19, both empty-square entries with %R flat near the top, both lost): 'sideways never pays; we need to enter on trending up on %R for open squares'.
prior: LOW as a loss reducer, ~NONE as a profit maker. In-sample look 10/9 on 308 desk fills 9/26-10/9 (logged live r/rs, 10-min change; up >= +15 / flat / down <= -15; all figures GROSS, no costs): FAST line (the line this rule uses) up n 187 trade -1.6 bp, +15 min -5.0 bp; flat n 112 trade -6.1 bp, +15 min -12.5 bp; down n 9. Keeping only fast-up fills vs all fills implies only ~+1.7 bp per trade at the exit and ~+2.8 bp at +15 min (base ~ -3.3 bp), BELOW the +3 bp bar; the filter keeps ~61% of fills. The larger slow-line split (+8 bp, t ~1.3) is NOT what is tested. Earlier: 'both lines rising' at the -50 cross matched random minutes; falling square/presquare entries ~0.25-0.30% worse (n 26). The 10 sessions 9/26-10/9 are SEEN and excluded from scoring. Most of the 308 in-sample fills predate presquare-only (live from 10/9), so they are not a presquare-only prior.

rule.knob: ai_watch_wr_trend_min_rise (default 0 = off). Applies to EMPTY-SQUARE (presquare) arms only, i.e. the live entry (ai_watch_presquare_only=true on the mini since 10/8; if that live setting changes, sessions are stratified and the count restarts). When > 0, a presquare arm that would otherwise buy is refused unless the fast %R now minus the fast %R recorded for that symbol ~600 s earlier is >= the knob.
rule.history: recorded in ONE place: the poll's warm step, once per ai_watch_poll_sec grid tick, per watched symbol, the value of rec['indicator']['pctr'] AND its pctr_src. None values are skipped. The 'earlier' value is the latest record at or before now - 600 s that is no more than 90 s older than that point. The two ends must have the same pctr_src, else refused as wr_src_mismatch. History is CLEARED when a name is dropped from the watch (no carry across a drop and re-add). Live and replay run the same code on the same poll grid.
rule.refusals: wr_not_trending (rise < knob), wr_no_history (no qualifying earlier record, e.g. seated < ~10.5 min), wr_src_mismatch; all counted
rule.exhaustion_live: if ai_watch_exhaustion_live changes during the study (planned candidate after 10/15, docs/studies/WR_ACCURACY_2026-10-09.md), sessions before and after are stratified and the read counts only one regime
rule.variant_value: 15 points of fast %R over 10 minutes, fixed here

replay: nightly in scripts/tight_trail_replay.sh: 'wr_trend15' = the day's live config + ai_watch_wr_trend_min_rise=15; 'wr_rand' = the day's live config + a seeded random refusal of presquare ARM EPISODES (sha256(symbol|day|arm-episode index); a refused episode stays refused until the arm latch resets) at a share equal to the fraction of base's presquare BUYS that wr_trend15 removed that session, 1 - wr_trend15 trades / base trades (two-pass: base and wr_trend15 first, then wr_rand); a session whose wr_rand trade count is not within +-15% of wr_trend15's has an invalid wr_rand comparison (counted, left out of that leg), the 'just trade less' control that absorbs slot-freeing and re-entry effects; reference 'base' = the day's live config. Costing: tools/studies/replay_costing.py with a trade lacking an NBBO charged that variant's day-median spread (counted), not dropped. The config fingerprint is logged per session. Base is run twice on 3 sessions to measure replay non-determinism (information).
sessions: every desk session from 2026-10-12 on with a usable recording and the same live entry regime; ONE read at the first close with >= 30 such sessions (power: the honest prior is ~+2-3 bp/trade against a session sd of ~15-20 bp, so 10 sessions has ~10% power). A 10-session look is DIRECTION ONLY and cannot pass or fail. Max 40 sessions counted in the SCORED regime (after any stratification restart), then UNDERPOWERED = FAIL.
statistic: per session: (wr_trend15 net bp per trade) - (base net bp per trade), and (wr_trend15) - (wr_rand); means over sessions, t across sessions. Sessions with fewer than 5 wr_trend15 trades are excluded (counted).
pass: at the single read: wr_trend15 minus base >= +3 bp per trade with t >= 2.0, positive on >= 60% of sessions, AND wr_trend15 minus wr_rand > 0 with t >= 2.0, AND >= 300 base trades and >= 150 wr_trend15 trades. (A total-dollars condition is not used: with base net negative, fewer trades always 'wins' on dollars; wr_rand is the control for trading less.) A pass earns a skeptic review and then a live paper switch-on; it is a loss reducer, not a profit claim.
fail: anything else is FAIL at the read; UNDERPOWERED (thresholds not met by 40 sessions) = FAIL.
information_only: trades per session: base, wr_trend15, wr_rand
refusals split: wr_not_trending / wr_no_history / wr_src_mismatch, and the result with only the wr_no_history refusals applied (seat-age effect)
the slow-line rise of the variant's own trades (logged rs), not a verdict
replay non-determinism from the doubled base runs
no_retuning: 15 points, 10 minutes, the fast line and the presquare-only live entry are fixed; any other value is a new prereg.
caveats: the live fast %R is noisy vs the full tape (10/9 parity: median 4.6 pts, 80th pct 9.1); a 15-point rise is above that noise but not far above it
replay precision vs live is imperfect (replay sees no stale-tape refusals the same way); both arms share it
the filter interacts with slot use: fewer entries free slots for other names, which the replay models
~20 replay variants run nightly; one cell at t ~2 is expected somewhere by chance; this prereg has a single pre-declared read
script: knob in ai_entry_watch.py (default 0, fingerprinted), variant line in scripts/tight_trail_replay.sh, scorer tools/studies/wr_trend_read.py; written after this file is committed and may not change anything above
